title: We watched 2 focus groups of Georgia swing voters. They're not happy with the Iran war
summary: None of the 13 focus group participants — who all voted for President Trump in 2024 — said they would describe the military action in Iran as going well so far.
contentText:
None of the 13 focus group participants — who all voted for President Trump in 2024 — said they would describe the military action in Iran as going well so far.
